summary.text: Gayle Manning is a member of the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 52 in northeastern Lorain County. Her official biography says she is serving her fourth term and was elected Speaker Pro Tempore at the start of the 136th General Assembly, the first woman in that role.

paragraphs.text: The House biography says Manning spent 37 years as an elementary school teacher and received her bachelor's degree from Kent State University and her master's degree from The University of Akron.
It says she served on the North Ridgeville Planning Commission and on the North Ridgeville City Council from 2006 to 2007.
According to the biography, Manning served two four-year terms in the Ohio Senate, where she was elected Majority Whip and served as vice chair of the Finance Committee.
It says she now also serves on the Education, General Government, Finance, and Workforce and Higher Education committees.
It says she and her late husband, former Representative Jeff Manning, raised two children, and that she lives in Avon.
